paradigm: sole om_gfs + honest calibration + Kelly edge sizing

rule_definitions.negative edge entered: position_size_usd > 0 and forecast_prob - market_price < 0 (Kelly trades on edge; low absolute p is not a flag)
rule_definitions.saturated flat signal: sole raw YES-side p >= per-station honest ceiling (the calibration clamp engaged)
rule_definitions.calibration bound violated: YES-side calibrated_p outside [0,1] or above its ceiling (replaces the retired raw-%-edge rule)

rule_changes_2026_10_16: R3: absolute p_fused<0.6 -> edge < 0 (model below market). Under Kelly a deep-OTM penny (KBOS p=0.079 @ 0.025) is a good trade, not 'low conf'.
R4: p_fused>=0.9 -> booked p pinned at the per-station ceiling. 0.9 is normal under the honest ~0.98 ceiling; only true saturation flags.
R5: RETIRED raw %-edge (KAUS 3031% by construction on a penny entry) -> honest ceiling/unit-interval bound check; v2 honest-EV crawl is the gate.
